gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: Spaced-out letters, drawn with one steady pen. Bruno Ace SC strings its letters out like beads on a thread, while M PLUS Rounded 1c softens the sans-serif text with terminals that stop short of curling.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-bai-jamjuree: Horseshoe curves and heavy diagonals up front. Cherry Swash is built to command attention, whereas Bai Jamjuree is happiest staying light and round, with no stroke modulation at all.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-national-park: Heavy diagonals, horseshoe curves, plenty of swagger. National Park keeps its pressure and angle constant and its rounded letters open on one side, so extended text should move along smoothly beneath Cherry Swash.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-tenor-sans: Loud horseshoe curves, then a hush. Cherry Swash holds a uniform line your eye can trail like a thread, while Tenor Sans lets its stems run a touch heavier than its hairlines.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-albert-sans: Bold, grinning letters with room to spare. Happy Monkey gives its e wide gaps and a ruler-straight line, while Albert Sans keeps its apertures open down to tiny sizes.
